summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 18, 2026, in Hangzhou, China. The AGM will consider proposed resolutions, which the board supports and recommends shareholders and ADS holders vote in favor. Record dates are May 22, 2026, for shareholders (Hong Kong time) and ADS holders (New York time). Voting instructions for ADS holders must be given to the depositary, The Bank of New York Mellon. The company also filed its 2025 annual report on Form 20-F. This is a routine AGM notice, not a special situation requiring action. What to watch: no special event or structural change is involved.
